description: This source file defines the NoteDetailActivity class for an Android application. It manages the display of detailed note content, handles navigation to editing notes, and includes menu options for editing and deleting notes.

classes.name: NoteDetailActivity
classes.description: An activity that displays detailed information of a note and provides options to edit or delete it.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the theme and layout, retrieves the note by ID, and renders its content.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates UI elements with the note's title, category, and content.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for editing and deleting notes.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for navigation, editing, and deleting notes.
